topic: Polaris systematic excess (c8 verification of ISS-2915 tldr_evidence patch)
our_argument_summary: WIN-065 is Refuted by Data. Polaris's ~0.66° offset from true celestial pole (epoch 2026.0, declination 89.34°) fully accommodates the dome's claimed +0.27° 'systematic excess' at 35.9°N — the excess is not statistically distinguishable from zero given the polar diurnal envelope, atmospheric refraction, and single-reading measurement noise. The dome's own coordinate table contradicts PRED-NEW-001 (Oslo Polaris elevation 59.90° vs WGS84 59.91°N; 22 of 24 cities match WGS84 to ±0.05°). PRED-NEW-001 registered 2026-03-12 post-dates the standard observations it 'predicts' (retrodiction, not prospective). The dome's own site lists the broader 'Polaris altitude matches latitude' prediction as FALSIFIED 2026-03-15, making simultaneous claim/refutation incoherent. n(r)-refraction structural dilemma (Section 1.8) blocks the high-latitude escape clause.
